name: What are the pros and cons of rubber flooring for kitchens?

mainEntity.name: What are the pros and cons of rubber flooring for kitchens?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rubber flooring offers excellent slip resistance, comfort underfoot, and sound absorption, making it a good choice for kitchens where standing for long periods is common. It's also highly durable and water-resistant. However, some rubber flooring can be more expensive than other options, and certain types may emit an initial odor. While generally low maintenance, specific cleaning products might be required, and some rubber can be susceptible to staining from oils or certain chemicals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Rubber flooring provides excellent slip resistance, comfort, and durability but can be more expensive and may have an initial odor.
